name: ai-dev-protocol
description: Lightweight team workflow plugin for AI-assisted development and gated Apifox API/catalog/CLI synchronization.

interface.shortDescription: Router-first team workflow for AI-assisted development
interface.longDescription: Use AI Dev Protocol to guide coding agents through a lightweight team workflow for requirement intake, developer-branch workflow, Chinese specs, scope control, merge-back, commits, handoff, Apifox sync summaries, read-only interface/response-model catalogs, and separately authorized Apifox CLI synchronization into existing modules. It borrows useful skill-system practices without adopting heavy hidden workflow state.
defaultPrompt: Use AI Dev Protocol for this feature.
Help me clarify and implement one requirement.
Prepare a verified handoff and request merge-back approval for this AI branch.
Plan a safe Apifox CLI synchronization for an existing module.
